about:
# No Coyote Jumping
Ever wanted to make your platformer experience more miserable than it already is? Here's a mod that does just that! 
This mod disables coyote jumping in platformer, making your platformer experience even more miserable.

This mod will most likely break replay bots, so if you are a bot developer, I have added a soft toggle to the mod settings for you to programmatically disable.
